The name Batlah carries the meaning “Daughter of vow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Batlah usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of vow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
